# Example code snippet to test regex matching for process commands
import re

# Sample command strings
commands = [
    "1234 /usr/bin/python3 script.py",
    "5678 /usr/bin/node app.js",
    "9101 /bin/bash"
]

# Regex to match Python processes
command_regex = r"python.*"

# Check which commands match the regex
matching_processes = [cmd for cmd in commands if re.search(command_regex, cmd)]
print(matching_processes)  # Expected output: ['1234 /usr/bin/python3 script.py']
